steps: Create an Entra application and client secret. Note tenant ID, client ID and the service principal object ID.

Deploy the downloaded Azure template into the resource group containing the existing Sentinel-enabled workspace. Use its region. It creates eight Analytics tables, a direct-ingestion DCR and the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment.
Copy the deployment's ingestionEndpoint and dcrImmutableId outputs into RedRays. Enter tenant ID, client ID and client secret.
Send a test record, then enable the integration and save the schedule. Test success means Azure accepted the record. Check RedRaysExportHealth_CL in the workspace to verify visibility.

Enable the desired analytics rules after reviewing the first baseline. Initial import generates no finding alerts unless alertOnBaseline is enabled. Set the heartbeat threshold above your export interval and ingestion delay.
Import the workbook JSON through the Azure workbook advanced editor and select the workspace.
limitations: TimeGenerated is the time RedRays captures an export snapshot. Original source times are exported separately.

The supplied analytics rules have a one-day lookback and do not alert on older backlog. Adapt the lookback and frequency to your delivery delay. Heartbeat detection requires a previously received heartbeat in its lookback.
Delivery is at least once. Stable EventId and Revision support query deduplication but do not promise exactly-once incident creation.
ABAP and vulnerability findings retain source-record identity. Cross-scan semantic deduplication is not inferred.
Password findings are persisted positive detections, not completed audit runs. Legacy Java detections have no detection timestamp.
Profile parameter values are exported only for an explicit allowlist. Custom parameters are unrated and do not export their values.
Deleted source rows do not automatically resolve findings. Intermediate source edits between polls are not a complete audit trail.
Finding status changes do not automatically close existing Sentinel incidents.
Client secret is returned to users with SETTINGS_VIEW, as agreed for this version.
